subject: reasoning
question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

22, 24, 28, 30, 34, ?
solution:
Logic : Alternately (2) and (4) are added to each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8558fb36b9ce6812df3e72a79f3e03ccd7c2686f7b37593ba7019b7ed6bb738.png] 

Hence, "36" is the correct answer.
